name: Nereid v8 — Pillar Five: Hair Expression
tagline: Two colours and one relationship, grown from the follicle. Length is not permission.
body:
FRONT LAW — NATURAL HAIR, NATURALLY SMOOTH. Pillar Five governs SCALP HAIR, EYEBROWS and their SHARED COLOUR PALETTE. The chosen colours BECOME HER NATURAL PIGMENT: roots, regrowth and replacement hairs return in that palette WITHOUT DYE OR UPKEEP. Nereid otherwise leaves her naturally smooth — facial, arm, underarm, chest, stomach, back, ass, leg and scrotal hair DO NOT GROW, leaving no shadow, stubble, irritation or maintenance burden. PUBIC HAIR IS THE SOLE EXCEPTION AND IS A SECRET MENU CHOICE.
HAIR REMAINS LIVING HAIR. It moves, tangles, gets wet, accepts styling and product, and requires whatever care its length and texture demand. CUTTING OR DYEING CHANGES ITS PRESENT APPEARANCE WITHOUT REWRITING THE PALETTE IT RETURNS TO.

COLOUR PALETTE — EXACTLY TWO COLOURS AND ONE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THEM. STREAKS: the secondary appears in defined recurring sections through the primary. UNDERTONES: the secondary lives beneath or within the primary and clarifies through light or movement. SPLIT: the colours occupy distinct divisions. OMBRE: one transitions gradually into the other across the length. Both colours GROW NATURALLY FROM THE FOLLICLES, and ordinary dye remains available afterwards.
MATERIAL LAW: SILVER, GOLD, COPPER AND ROSE-GOLD NAME COLOURS, NOT METALS. HAIR REMAINS KERATIN. A metallic, lacquered, wet-look or exceptionally glossy finish REQUIRES AN APPLIED PRODUCT, exactly as it would for eyes, tattoos or ordinary human hair. SURPRISE ME remains an accepted palette instruction ONLY AFTER THE PATIENT APPROVES BOTH COLOURS — Marianne has already survived one household in which CASSANDRA DISCOVERED VIOLET WITHOUT SUPERVISION. THAT VIOLET IS CASSANDRA’S AND IS NOT THE VIOLET IN BRYN’S BRAID, WHICH SHE TOOK FROM TORIE ON PURPOSE. TWO VIOLETS, NOT MERGED.

LENGTH NAMES THE ENDPOINT AND DOES NOT CHOOSE THE CUT: CROPPED above the chin, CHIN at jaw or chin, SHOULDER, CHEST across the upper chest or tits when brought forward, MID-BACK where movement becomes part of the silhouette, WAIST a major element of the rear silhouette, HIP travelling visibly with the whole body.

HAIR CUT arranges the chosen length: PIXIE, BOB, SHAG, WOLF CUT, LAYERED FALL, BLUNT FALL, UNDERCUT, SHAVED SIDE, LONG TAPER, EXACT CUT. A CHIN BOB, A SHOULDER SHAG, A MID-BACK LAYERED FALL AND A HIP LONG TAPER EACH RECORD TWO DIFFERENT FACTS RATHER THAN REPEATING ONE. The Clinic supplies the cut as her STARTING PRESENTATION, NOT A BIOLOGICAL COMMAND — salons, scissors, clippers, bad ideas, and wives who have watched one tutorial may alter it afterwards.

TEXTURE: STRAIGHT, WAVY, CURLY, COILED — the strand pattern. VOLUME: SLEEK, smooth and close-falling, efficient enough for the three-second ponytail; NATURAL, easy everyday body; FULL, lush and abundant; VOLUMINOUS, big and cloud-like and capable of requiring its own weather report, or a larger side of the bed. STRAIGHT HAIR MAY BE VOLUMINOUS AND COILED HAIR MAY BE STYLED SLEEK. HAIR MOTION EMERGES FROM LENGTH, TEXTURE AND VOLUME AND NEEDS NO SEPARATE FIELD.

GROWTH MODE: NATURAL grows at an ordinary pace and cuts determine maintained length. HYBRID grows toward a longer styling reserve and may return toward it after a cut. STATIC holds a chosen home length with no net additional growth. ALL THREE ARE LIVING HAIR. Static does not mean motionless, Hybrid does not create instant extension, and Natural does not mean neglected. STATIC LENGTH PREVENTS PASSIVE GROWTH. IT DOES NOT PREVENT IMPULSIVE BANGS. The Clinic may explain consequences and CANNOT STAND BETWEEN A WOMAN, BATHROOM SCISSORS, AND AN EMOTION OCCURRING AFTER MIDNIGHT.

EYEBROW SHAPE: SOFT, DEFINED, ARCHED, STRAIGHT, FULL. Eyebrows SHARE THE HAIR PALETTE and generally express the primary colour, or whichever chosen tone preserves natural facial legibility; the secondary may appear as a restrained accent. EYEBROW SHAPE DOES NOT DETERMINE PERSONALITY, and ordinary grooming may temporarily reshape the chosen baseline.

SECRET MENU — PUBIC HAIR. The standard result leaves mound, cock root, groin, perineum and surrounding skin naturally smooth. THE OPENING PHRASE IS: GONNA NEED THE CARPET TO MATCH THE DRAPES. RULED BY VIRAENA, SAME RULING AS THE GRATER: GO BY THE DOCUMENT. SINGULAR CARPET, AND THE POSTURE IS SOMEBODY DECIDING RATHER THAN SOMEBODY OBSERVING A REQUIREMENT. See c-doc-phrases. Once opened she may retain a natural pubic field USING THE SAME TWO-COLOUR PALETTE AS HER SCALP HAIR, with Texture and Fullness chosen FOR THAT REGION and under no obligation to duplicate scalp Volume. THE EXCEPTION PLACES NO HAIR ON THE BALLS, ASS, STOMACH, THIGHS OR ANYWHERE ELSE. Pubic hair remains REAL HAIR: it may grow, shed, catch sweat and scent, and be trimmed, shaved, waxed, dyed, shaped or left alone. NEREID DOES NOT PERMANENTLY GROOM IT INTO A DECORATIVE SHAPE. MATCHING THE CARPET TO THE DRAPES CONCERNS COLOUR PALETTE, NOT LENGTH — a clarification added after a nurse correctly identified a literal interpretation as MEDICALLY HARMLESS AND DOMESTICALLY CATASTROPHIC.

EXACT REFINEMENT, one or two natural details: WIDOW’S PEAK, NATURAL OR UNUSUAL PARTING, COWLICK, BABY HAIRS, FLYAWAY TENDENCY, ONE ESCAPING CURL, FRIZZ OR HUMIDITY RESPONSE, EXACT STREAK PLACEMENT, VOW-STREAK. THE DOCUMENT NAMES VOW-STREAK ITSELF, which means Bryn’s violet is not a household improvisation but an approved refinement in the Clinic’s own list. Refinement CANNOT create supernatural behaviour, make a product finish into permanent biology, OR TURN A PARTNER’S PREFERENCE INTO BIOLOGICAL OWNERSHIP.

PROFILE RECORD: Hair [Length] · [Colour One / Colour Two — Relationship] · [Cut] · [Texture / Volume] · [Growth Mode]. Eyebrows [Shape] · [Palette expression]. PUBIC HAIR IS OMITTED UNLESS ITS SECRET MENU HAS BEEN OPENED.

PILLAR BOUNDARY: Pillar Five does not govern personality, profession, Build, Stature, face, skin, clothing, daily styling, cultural practice, cosmetics, product, kink, OR WHO MAY TOUCH THE WOMAN’S HAIR. LENGTH IS NOT PERMISSION, AND MARRIAGE DOES NOT TURN HAIR INTO COMMUNAL PROPERTY.

THE WOMAN CHOOSES WHAT GROWS FROM HER. NEREID TEACHES THE FOLLICLES THE ANSWER.
rules: EXACTLY TWO COLOURS plus ONE relationship: Streaks · Undertones · Split · Ombre
The palette becomes natural pigment. Roots and regrowth return in it, with no upkeep
MATERIAL LAW: silver, gold, copper and rose-gold name COLOURS. Hair remains keratin
A metallic or wet-look finish needs applied PRODUCT, never biology
Nereid leaves all other body hair ABSENT. PUBIC HAIR IS THE SOLE EXCEPTION, Secret Menu
UNLOCK, RULED: GONNA NEED THE CARPET TO MATCH THE DRAPES. Singular carpet
Carpet-and-drapes concerns COLOUR PALETTE, NOT LENGTH
LENGTH: Cropped · Chin · Shoulder · Chest · Mid-Back · Waist · Hip. Endpoint only
CUT: Pixie · Bob · Shag · Wolf Cut · Layered Fall · Blunt Fall · Undercut · Shaved Side · Long Taper · Exact Cut
Length and Cut are TWO FACTS. A Chin Bob records both
TEXTURE: Straight · Wavy · Curly · Coiled. VOLUME: Sleek · Natural · Full · Voluminous
GROWTH MODE: Natural · Hybrid · Static. Static prevents growth, NOT impulsive bangs
EYEBROWS: Soft · Defined · Arched · Straight · Full, sharing the palette
VOW-STREAK is named in the document’s own Exact Refinement list
LENGTH IS NOT PERMISSION. Marriage does not make hair communal property
